dedupe_keys.name: czech railway corridor 4g and 5g mobile coverage measurements in trains

description: Researchers at Brno University of Technology publish long-term measurements of 4G and 5G mobile network coverage experienced in trains along the main railway corridors of the Czech Republic. The repository holds raw measurement data as CSV per corridor, processed coverage maps in HTML and OpenStreetMap form, KML files of the base transceiver stations along the lines, and the MATLAB code used for processing, with a mirror on the authors' GitLab. Coverage: the Czech national railway corridors, measured over a long period up to 2026. Format and access: CSV, KML and HTML on IEEE DataPort (open access, free of charge with a free IEEE account) under CC BY 4.0, and on GitLab. Caveats: measured from specific trains and devices, so values include the loss through carriage walls; operators and dates of runs must be read from the files. Simulation uses: coverage along rail lines for the dependence of railway operations and passengers on mobile networks, gaps where communication fails during disruptions, and interdependency models of transport and telecom. Related records: Fjord5G gives maritime counterparts; the Breitbandatlas and Arcep maps give official coverage predictions.
